The two surfaces disagree on the label for the very session the owner named: list-1920.png shows "$282 this tab · $1035 with children" for e00f55c9, but page-1920.png shows "$282 this session · $1035 with children". SessionStats.cost (SessionStats.js:~133) calls `AICost.is_tab(r, summary)` with no sessions row (a VS Code tab has none) and `summary.data.kind` is evidently not set, so it falls back to "this session"; the list decides from `r.source/role/id`. Give both surfaces one tab test (for example the summary's kind, or the same row/index lookup), then re-shoot so both read "this tab".

The proof shots do not prove requirement 3's card: list-1920.png is the Table view, where e00f55c9 shows the line only because the page had already cached the summary. The Rail/preview card (AISessionView.js, `sessions-card-line`) uses `known_cost` and never asks, so a card opened cold shows "$282 this tab · with children …" with no way to fill it in. The owner asked that the selected or opened card ask the summary for that one session; add that ask there and shoot the card itself.

list-1920.png: the deputy and onboarding mastermind rows show "with children …" as an underlined click target, not a number, until clicked; that is by design (no fan-out) but reads as unfinished next to the finished row above it.

AICost.js `cost_line`: before the summary arrives the page tile reads "$X this session · with children …" using the day snapshot's `usd`, which the old code called inflated; a brief flash of a different number than the final own figure is possible.

The one function (`AICost.cost_line`) and the single cached `AICost.summary` with in-flight de-duplication are a clean, simple shape; the Cost tab now opens with the child-session list, which satisfies the proof-link ask (page-1920.png shows the dotted link).

answer.reply: fixed: one tab test, AICost.is_tab(row, summary), on both surfaces. A VS Code tab's record says so on line 1 ({session:{kind:'vscode-tab'}}); Session now keeps that kind as a field (80cce72d4), so the summary carries data.kind and the page says 'this tab' without needing a row. Servex reads Session.js at start, so this goes live with the restart that follows the merge; the page shot is retaken then.

fixed: 4d795a00e. The rail card draws the same parts as the row (AISessionView.cost_parts) and has the same one-session ask. Proof: card-1920.png, Rail view reached from AI -> Sessions, the card cold read '$285 this tab · with children …' and after its ask '$285 this tab · $1054 with children', with the page url unchanged (the click does not open the row).

declined: on purpose. Asking every row would make the list ask Servex for hundreds of sessions (the read that froze Servex for 70-107 s, 2026-10-24); the dotted 'with children …' says the number is one click away.
declined: the snapshot's own figure and the summary's own figure are the same transcript ($282 against $281.92 here), so the first number does not visibly change; only 'with children …' fills in.
